Investment Segments

The strategy comes
before the asset.

BRAZILINK organizes its opportunity pipeline around the investor’s objectives, target return, preferred geographies and desired real estate exposure. Each segment is assessed through a distinct lens so that asset selection begins with a clear investment thesis rather than with an isolated property.

Segment 01

Residential

Residential opportunities include ready apartments, houses, condominiums and selected high-quality properties aimed at investors seeking long-term appreciation, portfolio diversification or lifestyle exposure.

What it includes

Ready residential inventory, second homes, premium condominiums and selected assets in consolidated or emerging neighborhoods.

Typical investment thesis

Capital appreciation, preservation of value, portfolio diversification and selective exposure to locations with resilient demand.

What BRAZILINK evaluates

Location, pricing, property condition, condominium quality, local demand, comparable transactions and future resale liquidity.

Segment 02

New Developments

New developments provide access to primary-market projects still under construction or recently launched, allowing investors to enter early in the commercial cycle of a selected project.

What it includes

Apartments and units sold directly by developers in selected launches, phases and inventory releases.

Typical investment thesis

Early-cycle pricing, potential appreciation during construction and access to projects with strong positioning and demand.

What BRAZILINK evaluates

Developer track record, construction stage, payment schedule, sales velocity, product differentiation and expected delivery quality.

Segment 03

Income & Leasing

Income and leasing opportunities are structured around recurring cash flow, contractual income and assets capable of producing stable rent over time.

What it includes

Income-producing residential or commercial assets, properties already leased and assets with clear leasing potential.

Typical investment thesis

Yield generation, cash-flow visibility, portfolio stability and long-term income supported by tenant demand.

What BRAZILINK evaluates

Rent levels, vacancy risk, tenant profile, operating costs, lease terms, location strength and income sustainability.

Segment 04

Land & Development

Land and development opportunities focus on assets where value can be created through construction potential, repositioning, subdivision, redevelopment or the structuring of a new real estate product.

What it includes

Urban plots, expansion areas, redevelopment sites, beachfront land and selected mixed-use development opportunities.

Typical investment thesis

Build-to-sell, build-to-rent, land banking, mixed-use projects and medium- to long-term value creation.

What BRAZILINK evaluates

Zoning, title regularity, infrastructure, licensing path, technical constraints, surrounding market and development feasibility.

Segment 05

Commercial & Corporate

Commercial and corporate real estate includes office and business-oriented properties for investors seeking urban exposure, corporate demand and strategic commercial positioning.

What it includes

Offices, commercial floors, business buildings, retail-oriented spaces and selected corporate assets.

Typical investment thesis

Rental income, corporate demand exposure, urban diversification and selective acquisition in established business districts.

What BRAZILINK evaluates

Micro-location, access, tenant demand, building quality, occupancy profile, condominium costs, pricing and liquidity.

Segment 06

Logistics & Mixed-Use

Logistics and mixed-use assets combine operational real estate with demand generated by distribution, industry, services and, in selected cases, more than one complementary use within the same project.

What it includes

Warehouses, logistics facilities, distribution centers, industrial properties and selected mixed-use complexes.

Typical investment thesis

Income generation, operational demand, infrastructure-driven value and diversification through assets linked to the real economy.

What BRAZILINK evaluates

Access to highways and urban centers, tenant demand, technical specifications, occupancy costs, expansion potential and market liquidity.

Segment 07

Tourism & Hospitality

Tourism and hospitality opportunities are linked to destinations where leisure, lifestyle and visitor flows support hotel, resort and hospitality-driven real estate demand.

What it includes

Hotels, pousadas, resorts, serviced residences, leisure properties and selected destination-driven assets.

Typical investment thesis

Tourism exposure, operating income, destination appreciation and participation in markets with recurring leisure demand.

What BRAZILINK evaluates

Destination strength, operator logic, occupancy potential, seasonality, capex, competitive positioning and revenue-generation potential.

Segment 08

Sale & Leaseback

In a sale & leaseback transaction, a company sells the property it occupies and remains as tenant, creating an investment backed by a defined lease and an operating business.

What it includes

Factories, warehouses, headquarters, operating facilities and other mission-critical properties occupied by the seller.

Typical investment thesis

Contractual income, long-duration leases, defensive cash flow and real estate exposure supported by business continuity.

What BRAZILINK evaluates

Tenant credit, lease duration, rent sustainability, strategic relevance of the property, guarantees and exit optionality.

A diversified pipeline, guided by a clear investment thesis.

BRAZILINK can structure the search according to the investor’s preferred segments and profile, combining local origination, curation and disciplined analysis.
